body: Hi, I recently moved house and need to update my home address on the system. How do I do this? Thanks, Megan
Hello, I have dyslexia and I think I need extra time in my exams this year. How do I go about arranging this? I haven't done this before so not sure what I need to send over. Thanks, Josh
Hi, I've been really struggling lately and don't know who to talk to. It's been building up for a while now and I just don't really know where to start. Priya
Hi, I'm having trouble paying rent this month and I'm really worried about it. Is there any support available for this? Thanks, Callum

Hello, two things - first, two of my modules have a timetable clash on Wednesdays which I need sorting before term starts. Separately, I have a mobility impairment and the room for one of my seminars is up two flights of stairs with no lift, which I can't manage, so I need that moved to an accessible room. My evidence letter from occupational health is already on file with Disability Services from last year. Thanks, Aisha
